items.rationale: Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) cover the failed indoor supply pipe and the standard sealing and insulation used to repair it. One materials flat rate is estimated at €180 gross using the comparable components in Case 39.

Section 7.1.7(g) covers the labour needed for the pipe repair. The invoice bills one flat rate, not one hour; €825 gross is based on the comparable installer and service-technician charges in Case 39.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge per contractor per invoice. The sole charge on this invoice is one flat rate at €81 gross.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover necessary drying and allow one equipment deployment charge per drying operation. One flat rate at the reference level is €439 gross.

items.description: Close and repaint the disturbed wall patch
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(a) covers making good the necessary access opening, and §7.1.5 limits the work to the affected patch. One wall reinstatement item at the reference level is €453 gross.
